title: Lopez Research：Anthropic估值重估，开源模型施压
speaker: Maribel Lopez

segments.en: You mentioned about Anthropic. Now that we're trading below the IPO price, do you think Jensen Huang coming back to Nvidia
segments.zh: 你提到Anthropic。既然交易价已低于发行价，你认为黄仁勋回归英伟达

segments.en: is good news for Nvidia, but bad news when it comes to Anthropic, given the fact that Jensen Huang has been such a proponent
segments.zh: 对英伟达是好消息，但对Anthropic是坏消息，因为黄仁勋一直是开放权重的

segments.en: and supporter of Open Weight. I mean, how do you see, how do you differentiate between the Open Weight and closed weight sort of a debate here right now?
segments.zh: 倡导者和支持者。你怎么看，如何区分开放权重和闭源权重之争？

segments.en: I definitely think that this was part of the calculus. I think when there was an assumption that Jensen was not going to be part of the picture of Nvidia
segments.zh: 我认为这确实是考量的一部分。当人们假设黄仁勋不会参与英伟达时

segments.en: that actually down plated stock it actually released money for Anthropic stock.
segments.zh: 这实际上压低了股价，释放了资金给Anthropic权益资产。

segments.en: So that was actually good for Anthropic in the short term.
In the longer term, what we have to worry about is what are the fundamentals of how much can you charge enterprises for AI models going forward,
segments.zh: 长期来看，我们要担心的是基本面：未来能向企业收取多少AI模型费用，

segments.en: particularly with the fact that we've seen some very compelling models coming out of Asia that are Open Weight and are quite good.
segments.zh: 尤其是亚洲出现了一些非常有吸引力的开放权重模型，而且相当不错。

segments.en: So that actually pushes pressure on the market not just for an Anthropic, but for Open AI and for anybody that develops models.
segments.zh: 这给市场带来压力，不仅对Anthropic，对OpenAI和所有模型开发者都是如此。

segments.en: So it's how many streams you can come up with. I will say that Anthropic had some good releases this week on software development and if they can convince more people to go with their software development platform
segments.zh: 所以关键在于你能推出多少产品线。Anthropic本周在软件开发方面有一些不错的发布，如果能说服更多人使用他们的软件开发平台

segments.en: they can probably keep that accelerated Web New Flywheel going for the next couple of quarters which is really what they need to prove to the market that they're not like a one or two quarter wonder
segments.zh: 他们可能还能让加速的Web New Flywheel再持续几个季度，这正是他们需要向市场证明的：他们不是昙花一现。

segments.en: that they have a sustainable lead in the enterprise and that they can keep it.
segments.zh: 他们在企业市场有可持续的领先优势，并能保持下去。

segments.en: Yeah, we had a guest just this week saying,
segments.zh: 是的，我们本周刚有一位嘉宾说，
